name: @capybearista/opencode-auto-advisor
description: OpenCode V2 plugin that provides an independent Advisor: explicit zero-argument consultation, experimental Zen automatic routing with observe and active modes, digest-only telemetry, and same-turn system-context advice delivery
author: capyBearista <capybearista@github.com>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && bun build src/index.ts --outfile=dist/index.js --target=bun --external '@opencode/*' && bun build src/tui.ts --outfile=dist/tui.js --target=bun --external '@opencode/*' --external '@opentui/*' --external 'solid-js'
